landing.description: We're building an AI that sells products on social media like a real human. We need your help to test it. You'll visit our Instagram store, interact with the AI as a real customer would, and then tell us about your experience.
landing.step2: Chat with the AI like a real customer
landing.step3: Answer a short survey about your experience
landing.discountText: After you finish, enter your name, phone, and email to unlock SellioAI 100% FREE — a full free access code, for yourself or anyone you choose.

flowSelector.heading: Who are you?
flowSelector.customerSubtitle: Test the AI as a real shopper

instagramCta.title: Visit Our Instagram Store
instagramCta.description: Click the button below to open our Instagram store in a new tab. The store is powered by our AI sales agent.
instagramCta.afterClick: Instagram opened in a new tab!
instagramCta.afterClickDesc: Come back to this tab after you've finished testing.

instructions.title: How to Test
instructions.subtitle: Act like a real customer. Be natural and honest.
instructions.instruction1Desc: Look through the store's products like you normally would.
instructions.instruction2Desc: Message the page with questions about products, prices, or shipping.
instructions.instruction3Desc: Attempt to place an order as a real customer would.
instructions.instruction4Desc: Don't go easy on the AI. Treat it like any other store.
instructions.instruction5Desc: Stop when you've completed an order, the AI fails, or you decide to stop.
instructions.reminder: Remember: Come back to this tab when you're done!

thankYou.title: Thank You! 🎉
thankYou.subtitle: Your feedback is invaluable
thankYou.description: You've just helped us improve our AI sales agent. Your honest feedback will shape the future of AI-powered commerce.
thankYou.detail: Your responses have been recorded and will be analyzed to improve the AI's performance, accuracy, and customer experience.
thankYou.share: Want to help more? Share this testing link with others!
thankYou.merchantDescription: Your business insight is exactly what we need. You've helped us understand what real store owners expect from an AI sales agent.
thankYou.merchantDetail: Your responses have been recorded and will directly shape our pricing, features, and roadmap.
